)

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: Clear Page
parts:
Do you mean an actionButton? or is ActionRun a development feature? 

Have you tried wrapping everything into an if - else type clause?

if (actionButtonInputId == 1) {
   output$Text1 <- ...
} else {

  output$Text0 <- ...
}

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: Clear Page
parts:
sorry that should have been

input$actionButtonInputId

You can also try something like this to take care of situation where the actionButtonInputId has not yet been defined (if it appears on the server side wrapped into conditionals):

if (is.null(input$actionButtonInputID) || !nzchar(input$actionButtonInputID) || input$actionButtonInputID == 0) {
  output$Text0 <- ...
} else { 
  output$Text1 <- ...
}

modulo some typos
